pitch_headline: A SuperSite backed by a fresh five-star reputation.
pitch_body: This version of the SuperSite for Pools By G.E. brings early five-star trust forward and gives that reputation a more credible, inquiry-ready front end.
text_line: 20 five-star reviews and no website. Quick SuperSite demo for Pools By G.E.
call_script: Hey, this is Bryan with JAWSAI. Pools By G.E. is at 5.0 with 20 reviews and no website collecting the next jobs. I put together a quick SuperSite demo - reviews front and center, after-hours capture, automatic follow-up. Takes about 30 seconds.
section_title: A SuperSite that helps newer trust feel established faster.
section_copy: When the reviews are already strong, the site should make the business feel more mature, more credible, and easier to contact.
